name: c5-sentinel-sar-dev-tools
description: Dev-only tooling for C5 Sentinel-SAR. The prototype itself (index.html) stays dependency-free and loads directly in a browser with no build step; this package.json exists only to run the test scripts (Playwright browser tests, smoke scripts) locally and in CI (WP-13). Not required to open or use the prototype - see CLAUDE.md.
